supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: moderate lateral extension beyond the outer periocular boundary

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: lighter pixel intensity in the muzzle region contrasted against the darker cheek and periocular regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: visible lower lip with moderate vertical thickness and apparent structural droop

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: severe structural anomaly/mutilation of the right ear pinna
